updateChecklist: Quarterly: (1) check US share of VT on Vanguard's page, (2) check EM share of VXUS, (3) spot-check the biggest expense ratios below, (4) update splits/marketIntl/ers, (5) each November update limits from the IRS announcement, (6) bump asOf and version, commit. NOTE: gold/REIT/commodity/crypto/managed-futures funds auto-create their own category on entry (see AUTO_CATEGORY in the HTML); equity factor styles (momentum, quality, dividend, sectors) classify as their underlying US/intl stock. To recognize a new alternative fund, add it to AUTO_CATEGORY; to recognize a new stock/bond fund, add it to TICKER_GUESS.
